method: One warmup followed by five measured episodes; budget compares the median. Fixture construction is included. Counters are reset before every episode and reported from src/instrumentation.ts. Budgets are deliberately above the initial baseline so normal scheduler noise does not fail the run.

rapidStreaming.fixture: legacy 30,520-grapheme reveal episode (61 ticks), closest available old-framework equivalent

largeTranscript.fixture: No like-for-like baseline: the old transcript benchmark only measures 500, 5,000, and 50,000 committed blocks.

logDocument.fixture: The closest old markdown-stream benchmark failed during Stage B with `React is not defined` before measurement; no number was fabricated.

agentTree.fixture: No old-framework benchmark exists for retained keyed agent-tree updates.

renderMethod: render.tsx mounts the real native renderer: a 2,000-block transcript plus 100 live tail paints, a 50,000-line log preview plus append, 200 keyed agent selections, and 1,000 document append/paint cycles. One warmup and five measured episodes; fixture construction and teardown included. Node identity and zero remaining timers are hard invariants. Timing ceilings are roughly three times the observed optimized native medians, not comparisons with the primitive-only scenarios below.
